findings.body:
Gain 3, Work 2, Harm 3
Raise: Functional. src/forge/board_trends.py:91-94 explicitly returns null team and person counts for incomplete weeks; src/forge/board_facts.py:132-133 produces this state when a weekly search reaches 1,000 merges. This helper converts those unknown counts to zero. Consequently, lines 16-17 can report that nothing merged when a week is unknown, and lines 50-63 calculate six-week shares using only the known weeks without disclosing the omission. Preserve unknown through the empty-state check and share calculation.

findings.body:
Gain 3, Work 2, Harm 3
Raise: Not done. Kept-finding titles are copied verbatim into visible browser tooltips here; next-release story and fix titles are likewise copied at lines 101 and 106. Command-bearing titles are real repository data: .factory/stories/FORGE-MAINONCE-1/tasks/SPOTTED.json:60-64 contains a follow-up titled "forge next names the wrong file when a per-item record is unreadable", which src/forge/known_issues.py:14-24 passes through unchanged. Hovering that file therefore exposes command text outside the plan. The browser proof uses command-free fixtures and scans inner_text(), which excludes these title attributes. Render these titles without command text and cover command-bearing input.

findings.body:
Gain 3, Work 2, Harm 3
Raise: Functional. The finding titles are available only through the title attribute of a non-focusable list item. A sighted keyboard user can read each filename and count but cannot focus the entry or reveal which problems were kept. Provide a keyboard-accessible way to expose the same titles. The keyboard proof at tests/test_board_releases_insights.py:105-117 only reaches the header links, so it misses this path.
